findings.current: What do you think would happen if you muttered to yourself that I’d tried to assassinate you just now?
findings.defect: Reverses who supposedly tried to assassinate whom and who would make the accusation.
findings.rationale: The Emperor threatens to say that Taekyung tried to assassinate him.
findings.replacement: What do you think would happen if I muttered to myself that you’d just tried to assassinate me?
findings.source: 지금 당장 자네가 짐을 시해하려고 했다는 혼잣말을 하면 어떻게 될 것 같나?

findings.current: I knew this day would come. I’ve known for a long time. So…
findings.defect: Knowing what would happen replaces the Emperor’s claim that he had steeled himself for it.
findings.rationale: 각오했던 describes resolve or preparedness, not mere foreknowledge.
findings.replacement: I was prepared for this. Have been for a long time. So…

findings.current: His flesh and blood, dear enough to hold in his sight without ever tiring of him.
findings.defect: The literalized image obscures an idiom expressing how precious his younger brother is to him.
findings.rationale: 눈에 넣어도 아프지 않을 conveys extreme affection, not pleasure in looking at someone.
findings.replacement: His flesh and blood, so precious he could never bear to see him hurt.

findings.current: the boy would have to become a conqueror, not a sage king.
findings.defect: “Conqueror” suggests territorial conquest rather than the forceful, domineering rulership contrasted with a sage king.
findings.rationale: 패왕 characterizes the kind of ruler needed to survive the coming war.
findings.replacement: the boy would have to become a ruthless ruler, not a sage king.
findings.source: 성군이 아닌 패왕(霸王)이 되어야 한다.

findings.defect: Using the same pronoun twice erases the Emperor’s deliberate shift from imperial self-reference to speaking as a person.
findings.rationale: 짐은 changes to 나는 immediately before he admits that he wants to live.

findings.current: the help of Baek Yeon and Gungseong
findings.defect: Uses an untranslated form instead of the established title.
findings.rationale: The packet’s glossary establishes Bow Saint for 궁성.
findings.replacement: the help of Baek Yeon and the Bow Saint

findings.current: having been taught by two peerless masters—Gungseong and Baek Yeon—
findings.defect: The second occurrence also uses an untranslated form of the established title.
findings.rationale: The packet’s glossary establishes Bow Saint for 궁성.
findings.replacement: having been taught by two peerless masters—the Bow Saint and Baek Yeon—
findings.source: 궁성과 백연이라는, 말이 필요 없는 훌륭한 스승들의 가르침을 받으며

findings.current: he let out a series of dry coughs.
findings.defect: “Dry” specifies a quality absent from the source; the coughs are small or light.
findings.rationale: 잔기침 refers to light, repeated coughing.
findings.replacement: he let out a series of small coughs.

summary: One line reverses the parties to an alleged assassination; several others lose the Emperor’s emotional or political meaning.
